Today's terms

Page Size - The number of items that each page contains.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Pagination, Page Size and Cursor in English?

dialogue.title: The endless feed

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the feed has ten thousand posts. The app takes forever to load.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Do not load them all. Use pagination.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It loads the list in small pages, instead of all at once.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How many posts are in one page?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is the page size. In our code, `size` is twenty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not for a phone. A larger page size means a slower first load.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how does the server know which page to send next?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It returns a cursor, like `nextCursor` in our code. It marks where the next page starts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So I send the cursor back to get the next page.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. If the cursor is nil, there are no more pages.
